question: Should memory-core Dreaming accept a new user-facing localization surface, and should it be a constrained locale setting, a custom template/prompt override, or no new surface for now?
rationale: The request is useful and source-reproducible, but it expands plugin config and localization policy in a compatibility-sensitive area, so automation should not choose the permanent public contract.

options.title: Review the linked locale PR first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101323 as the implementation candidate, but require maintainers to settle the accepted locale/template contract and proof before merge.

options.title: Consolidate under the older design issue
options.body: Keep this paired issue open for the current PR, but make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79223 the broader design tracker for language and prompt customization.

options.title: Decline Dreaming localization for now
options.body: Keep English structural labels until maintainers choose a broader localization strategy for generated memory artifacts.

recommendation.title: Review the linked locale PR first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101323 as the implementation candidate, but require maintainers to settle the accepted locale/template contract and proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest recent contributor signal across Dreaming config/report surfaces and is a good first routing candidate for the product/API choice.
